dimensions.assessment: Affects federal agencies (NOAA, Coast Guard), the Marine Debris Foundation, coastal communities, and Indian Tribes involved in marine debris programs.
dimensions.evidence: develop and implement best practices for conducting outreach to Indian Tribes and Tribal Governments.

dimensions.assessment: Makes administrative changes, modifies foundation leadership structures, and authorizes specific funding levels for a single fiscal year while extending program authorization.
dimensions.evidence: designates the current Chief Operating Officer... as the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) and specifies that the board has the authority to appoint... the CEO.

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes appropriations of $2,000,000 for fiscal year 2025 for the Marine Debris Foundation and extends NOAA program authorizations through FY2029.
dimensions.evidence: in paragraph (1), by inserting 'and $2,000,000 for fiscal year 2025' after 'through 2024'

dimensions.assessment: Amends the Marine Debris Act and the Save Our Seas 2.0 Act to update program administration, in-kind contributions, and organizational structures.
dimensions.evidence: To amend the Save Our Seas 2.0 Act to improve the administration of the Marine Debris Foundation, to amend the Marine Debris Act to improve the administration of the Marine Debris Program

dimensions.assessment: Extends program authorizations through fiscal year 2029 and makes permanent structural changes to the foundation and statutes.
dimensions.evidence: for each of fiscal years 2018 through 2029 for carrying out

missing_information: Total aggregated multi-year funding authorizations beyond the specific FY2025 foundation amount are not fully detailed in numerical totals within the text.
importance_detail.rationale: Reauthorizes the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration's Marine Debris Program through FY2029, reauthorizes the Marine Debris Foundation for FY2025 at $2,000,000, and modifies administrative and tribal outreach practices.

latest_action.text: Referred to the Subcommittee on Coast Guard and Maritime Transportation.
